items.name: Group order book, FY2025 (year ended 31 October 2025)
items.claim: Chemring reported another record order book of GBP 1,345 million, providing excellent medium-term revenue visibility.
items.source_excerpt: Another record order book of £1,345m, providing excellent medium-term revenue visibility.

items.name: Order book coverage of expected FY2026 revenue
items.claim: Chemring said approximately 76% of its expected 2026 revenue is already covered by the order book, versus 77% at the same point the prior year.
items.source_excerpt: Approximately 76% (2024: 77%) of expected 2026 revenue is already covered by the order book

notes: The order-book coverage figure (item 2) is a forward revenue-visibility metric closest in kind to RPO; Chemring does not report an IFRS remaining-performance-obligation line. No individually named contract or award, nor a product/project pipeline disclosure, was found in the stored FY2025 results release.

changelog.change: run pipeline CHEMRING-GROUP (munitions-replenishment). Created COMPLETE pipeline with 1 BACKLOG item (record GBP 1,345m order book at 31 October 2025) and 1 RPO item (76% of FY2026 revenue already covered by order book), both cited from the stored FY2025 results press release.
